input: Shortlist three caterers for the office end-of-year party

gold.taskTitle: Shortlist three caterers for the office party
gold.taskDescription: Identify and shortlist exactly three catering companies suitable for the office end-of-year party.

questions.title: How many guests are expected to attend?
questions.description: Understand the headcount to filter caterers by capacity.

questions.title: What is the total catering budget?
questions.description: Know the spending limit to shortlist only affordable caterers.

questions.title: What date and location is the party?
questions.description: Confirm the venue and date to check caterer availability and travel range.

questions.title: What style of service do you want?
questions.description: Determine whether the event calls for buffet, sit-down, food stations, or canapes.

questions.title: Are there dietary requirements to accommodate?
questions.description: Identify any vegetarian, vegan, halal, kosher, or allergy-related needs.

questions.title: What cuisine type or theme is preferred?
questions.description: Establish whether there is a preferred food style such as local, international, or themed menu.

questions.title: Who has final approval on the shortlist?
questions.description: Clarify whether one person decides or if a committee reviews the shortlisted caterers.
